identity: Recognizable silhouettes, leafy crown/branch limbs, flame core/vine cage and stone armor/orange chest accents match the approved Flora designs. The replacement is not pixel-identical: altered saturation and alpha fringes require human review. No identity repair or color editing was performed. Conceptual identity is preserved; exact proportions/pose details differ from the JPEG references, especially the Sentinel helmet/torso. This is a human REVIEW finding, not a claim of a lossless JPEG-to-alpha conversion.
normalization: external_crop_grid_v1: fixed declared source cells, per-column/per-row translation into stable frame boxes. All 836858 visible RGBA pixels transferred exactly once; zero RGB/alpha edits, no resampling. Transparent RGB padding discarded only where alpha is zero.
environment: Both forest scenes preserved as art-direction only. Forest green/stone palettes and orange emissions fit references; current geometric forest fixture is a scale/compositing evaluation, not a completed forest map. Directional lighting generally top/front; creature shading is more detailed than Sieg/Coco.
qa_scope: Two independent clients verified deterministic fixed-time presentation; not network entity QA. Four responsive viewports captured; portrait preserves full scene but details/text become small.
video_preparation: Primary review is a conventional video transcode of raw capture seconds 3–21, excluding startup and later fixed-frame capture. Original raw videos retained.
